purpose: @pathto on the tracked page named '404' must emit root-absolute web paths, because a deployed 404 document is served at any request depth and has no meaningful relative location. All existence/dependency checking is unchanged; only the path representation differs.
trigger: Warden 404-page authoring exposed that relative @pathto paths from a 404 document are wrong when the browser request path depth is arbitrary.
fix: Parser::path_to emits root-absolute web paths when tracked_info_.name == '404' (index pages become '/dir/'; ordinary targets become '/dir/file.ext'), for targets under the output directory; targets outside it keep relative behaviour.
guard: tests/pathto_404_smoke.sh (make test-pathto-404), wired into the bh2-test-integrity CI-equivalent chain.

green_runs.case: 404 page: root, page, deep page, directory index, asset

red_runs.outcome: RED: 'neither a tracked name nor a file that exists' (existence checking intact)
